latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Facebook Video Editing With AI.

- Launches a cloud-based tool to edit and export Facebook videos using remote GPU nodes.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4s in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple instructions: upload raw clips and describe needed edits (trim, add captions, resize, etc.).
- Integrated anonymous token system: 100 free credits and 7-day sessions for new users.
- Interactive workflows: live status updates, session management, and clear action routing for video editing, export, credit checks, and more.
- Platform-specific formatting and export for Facebook posts and reels; best results under 60 seconds.
